`native-rgb-box.x_t` is a synthetic 40 × 30 × 20 mm box generated by
`parasolidts`: body RGB `[0.8, 0.2, 0.1]` with a green first-face override.
It contains native standard SDL/TYSA_COLOUR / SDL/TYSA_COLOUR_2 attributes.
The independent Python reader tests use it to verify face precedence and reject
broken references, ownership, and invalid RGB values.
